احتفرتم (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَرْتُمْ (iḥtafartum) /iħ.ta.far.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اُحْتُفِرْتُمْ (uḥtufirtum) /uħ.tu.fir.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
